query: Enable the Rodin3D_Detail generation branch: set its Preview3D node to enabled so the detailed model previews, and bypass the Rodin3D_Regular node together with its Preview3D node. Keep the shared input-image batching feeding all branches and leave every other node wired as it is.

desired.outcome: The Rodin3D_Detail branch is active and its Preview3D shows the generated model, while the Rodin3D_Regular branch and its Preview3D are bypassed.
desired.quality: The shared input-image batch still feeds all four Rodin variants; only Rodin3D_Regular and its Preview3D are bypassed, and no links are removed or left dangling.

_tags.author_rationale: This demands understanding the pipeline's structure and modifying a core component without breaking the rest, a genuine big adjustment.
